title: 752 Howth Road, Raheny, Dublin 5, D05VY40

seller.name: Barry Connolly
seller.branch: Lisney Sotheby’s International Realty Dublin North.

description:
No. 752 Howth Road, Dublin 5 is a distinguished detached residence of exceptional scale and potential in one of North Dublin’s most coveted coastal settings. Occupying an enviable position along the prestigious Howth Road, No. 752 is an elegant detached family residence extending to approximately 2,200 sq. ft. (205SQM), discreetly set amidst wonderfully private front and rear gardens in one of Dublin’s most established and sought-after residential locations.

Enjoying a remarkable sense of privacy and tranquillity, this fine home perfectly balances the serenity of suburban coastal living with exceptional connectivity, situated moments from Raheny Village, the DART, Dublin city centre and Dublin Airport. Rarely does a property of such scale, setting and potential come to the market in this highly regarded address.

Approached through a generous private frontage with mature planting and ample off-street parking, the property immediately conveys the character and substance of a cherished family home. While requiring modernisation, No. 752 presents a compelling opportunity for discerning purchasers to sensitively refurbish and reimagine a residence of genuine distinction, creating a contemporary home tailored to modern family living while preserving its inherent charm and proportions.

The accommodation is notably generous and adaptable, extending to approximately 2,200 sq. ft. and designed to accommodate the evolving needs of family life.At the heart of the home lies an impressive extended kitchen and breakfast room, a wonderfully proportioned space overlooking and opening onto the rear garden, ideally suited to both informal family gatherings and larger-scale entertaining. A separate utility room, with independent access to the front driveway, offers additional practicality and convenience.A particularly valuable feature of the property is the adapted room / granny flat, providing exceptional flexibility and lending itself equally well as guest accommodation, an independent workspace, study, playroom or private suite for extended family.Traditional reception space has been carefully preserved, with an elegant drawing room to the front enjoying a quiet outlook over the garden, while a generously proportioned formal dining room, complete with serving hatch to the kitchen, creates an ideal setting for entertaining. A ground floor bathroom further enhances the versatility of the accommodation.At first-floor level, the home comprises four well-proportioned bedrooms alongside a family bathroom, with ample scope to reconfigure or elevate the existing layout to meet contemporary requirements.The gardens are a defining feature of this exceptional home. To the rear, a magnificent mature garden extends to approximately 100 feet, offering a rare sense of seclusion and tremendous scope for further enhancement. Richly planted and enjoying a peaceful aspect, it provides an idyllic setting for outdoor living, family enjoyment and future potential, subject to the requisite planning permission. A block-built workshop / garden room offers excellent ancillary space for storage, hobbies or creative pursuits.

Few locations offer such an enviable balance of convenience and lifestyle. Positioned within easy reach of Raheny Village and excellent transport links, including the DART, the property enjoys effortless access to the city centre, major road networks and Dublin Airport, while benefiting from the calm and character of a mature coastal suburb.

The surrounding area offers an exceptional quality of life, with an abundance of renowned educational, recreational and natural amenities close at hand. Residents are spoiled for choice with nearby attractions including St Anne’s Park, the protected landscapes and beaches of Bull Island Nature Reserve, excellent golf courses and the celebrated coastal destinations of Howth and Sutton, renowned for their scenic walks, beaches, cafés and acclaimed restaurants.

No. 752 Howth Road represents a rare and compelling opportunity to acquire a substantial detached residence of immense promise in one of Dublin’s most desirable coastal settings — a home of enduring quality, ready to be thoughtfully reimagined for generations to come.
